g.text: But a special type of method
*** A method is a block of code which only runs when it is called.
[i] functions are named methods in java.
[*] To define a Class Method "static" keyword is needed
[*] Class Methods can be accessed by class reference (using class name)
[*] To access Class Methods objects are not needed
To access/use/call Instance Methods Object is required [*]
Instance Mehods are called by using Object Reference [*]
-> they are used to initialize objects
-> if not defined by user, default constructor is used
-> every class has a constructor by default
* In Java, a constructor must have the exact same
name as the class it's in
